decisions.reason: Although it is more peripheral than the firm's machinery lines, the accelerator still fits its advisory and partnership strengths and supports absorptive capacity by exposing the firm to external circular-economy knowledge, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

The infectious waste decontamination plant remains closely related to the firm's modular waste-treatment know-how and focus on decentralized systems, and its in-house R&D and learning from deployment make continued commercialization the likely choice.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is highly aligned with the firm's core engineering, manufacturing and service capabilities and directly supports its decentralization strategy, so management would be very unlikely to take it off the market.
